reddit.title: New Feature: Materials Overview for Building
reddit.body: We've made a significant improvement to how you manage resources in Provincia! Instead of a confusing cost chip, each build tile now displays a detailed Materials overview. You can easily see the materials required versus what you have stored, with shortages clearly highlighted. This change allows for better planning and management of your colony. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

embed.title: New Materials Overview for Building Tiles
embed.description: No more hidden costs! Each build tile now displays a detailed list of required materials and your current stock. This helps you manage your resources effectively and plan your colony better.

steam.title: Introducing Materials Overview for Building
steam.body: We're excited to share that we've improved resource management in Provincia! The new Materials overview on each building tile provides a clear view of what materials you need versus what you have stored. This update allows for better planning and makes building your colony more intuitive. Learn more about this feature in our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
